messages:
elaine: Heads up — DAST started failing against staging after the RBAC housekeeping. Tests show 401s on the auth proxy and CI logs surface a KMS error when fetching client TLS certs.
sec-bot: Alert: DAST-run-2026-03-21 (staging) returned 401 Unauthorized for multiple endpoints. Correlated KMS error detected.
vishal: That's odd — the proxy certs are pulled from KMS-wrapped secrets. Did someone change the proxy service account bindings during the tidy?
ops: I updated service accounts into infra-ops group around 07:10 UTC. I might have missed re-adding the KMS decrypt role to the proxy SA.
elaine: Can you paste the audit excerpt? We need clear KMS deny evidence before any suppression; reg will want the full chain for the ticket.
ops: From Cloud Logging: protoPayload.methodName=cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.access protoPayload.status.code=7 principalEmail=proxy-stager@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com resourceName=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/proxy/cryptoKeys/tls-key. Denies start at 07:12 UTC.
ci-bot: DAST job ids: dast-stg-2026-03-21-07 (failed), sast-stg-2026-03-21-01 (green). DAST failures started at 07:12 UTC and match the KMS denies window.
reg-compliance: For SOC2 evidence we need: 1) KMS audit logs for the full window, 2) the RBAC PR diff and reviewer list, 3) CI artifacts showing the 401s, and 4) a timeboxed suppression approval if you suppress findings.
vishal: If the proxy can't decrypt the cert it returns 401 and DAST reports that as a vulnerability. We should restore the KMS binding, re-run DAST, and only suppress if artifacts prove infra caused the failures.
ops: Rebinding command ready: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/proxy/cryptoKeys/tls-key --member=serviceAccount:proxy-stager@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
ops: Applied at 07:20 UTC. CLI output: Updated IAM policy for key tls-key. I extracted logs with: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=proxy-stager@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com AND protoPayload.status.code=7' --limit=100 --format=json > evidence-5432109876-kms-deny.json`
elaine: Excellent. Open a SEC ticket and attach the PR and those logs. I'll approve a short suppression for the DAST job only if the ticket contains that evidence and the rebind commit.
vishal: Ticket SEC-3002 opened, attached PR https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1303, the gcloud extract, and the failed DAST artifacts. I created suppression pattern=api/v1/* env=staging duration=3h reason='temporary while KMS decrypt restored' and tagged reg-compliance.
sec-bot: Suppression created by vishal for api/v1/* @ staging 1 expires in 3h. Labels: scan:temporary-suppression; reason=proxy KMS decrypt failure.
ci-bot: Re-run dast-stg-manual-543 results: 401 errors cleared; findings dropped from 23 -> 2 (low severity timing issues).
reg-compliance: Evidence looks sufficient. Keep suppression timeboxed and add a postmortem note: add RBAC checklist item for KMS perms, update infra PR template to require KMS role verification, and require a premerge simulation test for KMS deny.
elaine: Adding action items to SEC-3002 and scheduling a 20-minute sec-sync follow-up tomorrow. Thanks all.
ops: I'll update the infra PR template and open a small CI change to add a KMS-deny smoke test in the premerge matrix.
